purpose: Outcome-blind assignment audit of APBP candidate sites to SCAR ADD land polygons using the FeatureServer's own spatial engine.

source_sites.candidate_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years
source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: Only site coordinates, species identity, region labels, and temporal-coverage metadata are used. Population trends and endpoints remain unopened.

scar_add.dataset: High resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline

why_v3.v1_v2_issue: Local reconstruction of all SCAR polygons produced false absences despite the FeatureServer reporting land at known sites.
why_v3.diagnostic_result: Direct anchor queries confirmed service-side land coverage and representative FID geometry consistency at Palmer, South Shetlands, South Orkneys and Ross Sea anchors.
why_v3.v3_change_only: Use FeatureServer returnIdsOnly spatial queries directly for the frozen matching audit. No biological eligibility or threshold is changed.

spatial_match_audit.selection_rule: Choose the smallest distance at which at least 95% of candidate sites have one or more land-polygon IDs and no more than 5% have multiple land-polygon IDs. If no distance satisfies both criteria, Gate 1A fails.
spatial_match_audit.query_mode: FeatureServer returnIdsOnly; where surface='land'; WGS84 point input; ArcGIS geodesic distance in meters

next_gate_only_if_passed.name: Gate 1B minimal island-architecture traits
traits: distance to continental land for offshore islands
